formula: \dot q=\frac{\partial H}{\partial p},\qquad\dot p=-\frac{\partial H}{\partial q}

note.ja: 正準方程式と分離可能なHamiltonianの代表形。調和・4次ポテンシャルの振動子で、エネルギー誤差とシンプレクティック性を比べます。
note.en: Canonical equations and a representative separable Hamiltonian. Harmonic and quartic oscillators distinguish energy error from symplecticity.

title.ja: SHAKEとRATTLE：拘束と運動量の違い
title.en: SHAKE and RATTLE: constraints and momentum ownership

assumptions.en: L=m=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity. C=(q·q−1)/2, T=100 and h=0.04/0.02/0.01; position targets are fixed at 1e−13, with a coarse 1e−10 companion.

note.ja: 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。
note.en: Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency.

reference_note.ja: Jacobi解析族と独立角度ODE2計算を資格確認し、場・拘束の厳密法則・エネルギー仕事収支を比較します。 独立Jacobi解析族と角度系DOP853の資格、74主判定。有限Cの中心化恒等式、2段階FDの縮約写像診断、位置対／全状態の逆積分を分離。
reference_note.en: Qualify the Jacobi family against two independent angular ODE runs, then compare states, exact constraint laws and energy/work budgets. A separately qualified Jacobi family and angular DOP853 reference support 74 main decisions. Finite-C centered identities, two-delta reduced-map diagnostics and position-pair versus full-state reversals are distinct.

method_note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
method_note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.
